blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-grained visual perception remains a bottleneck during post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as perceptual errors can constrain gains from reasoning-focused optimization. Although image-caption pre-training improves perception, its influence can weaken as subsequent stages change data mixtures and objectives. Continuing caption supervision during post-training is challenging because subjective, information-dense descriptions complicate verifiable reward design. We present PerceptRL, which strengthens perception at two complementary levels. Perception RL uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract verified errors from dense image captions and convert the corresponding visual facts into QA pairs with fixed answer labels and rule-based rewards. Chain QA links correlated errors, while multiple-choice QA combines unrelated errors. A specialized route targets high-error domains with tailored verification, and a domain-agnostic general route covers errors beyond these domains. Perception Agentic RL addresses fine-grained and dense cases unresolved by single-turn Perception RL through multi-turn inspection with visual tools. We observe coordinate drift even in models trained to use tools, where incorrect crops or annotations distort evidence and propagate errors. Coordinate Injection corrects spatial operations in cold-start trajectories, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises intermediate spatial fidelity alongside final-answer correctness. Training proceeds through shared cold-start SFT, single-turn Perception RL, and multi-turn Perception Agentic RL. Across seven benchmarks under a shared tool-use protocol, PerceptRL achieves 71.6% average accuracy, surpassing the base model with the same tools and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 15.7 and 5.2 percentage points, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的后期培训中,精细的视觉感知仍然是一个瓶颈,因为知觉错误会限制从注重推理的优化中获得的收益. 虽然图像封装前训练会提高知觉,但其影响会随着后续阶段改变数据混合物和目标而减弱. 培训后继续进行字幕监督具有挑战性,因为主观、信息密集的描述使可核查的奖励设计复杂化。 我们提出 " 认知 " (PerceptRL),它加强了两个互补层面的认识。 Perception RL使用多代理管道从密集的图像标题中提取已核实的错误,并用固定的答案标签和以规则为基础的奖励将相应的视觉事实转换为QA对. 链式QA链接关联出错,而多选择QA结合了无关出错. 一个专门的路由以高error域为目标,并有定制的验证,一个域不可知的一般路由覆盖了这些域以外的出错. 感知Agentic RL通过有视觉工具的多回转检查,解决了被单回转Peption RL所未解决的精细而密集的案件. 我们观测到坐标漂移,即使是在受过使用工具训练的模型中,错误的作物或说明扭曲了证据并传播了错误。 坐标注入会纠正冷起动轨迹中的空间操作,而地心意识过程的奖励则会监督中间空间忠诚度与最终答案正确性. 训练通过共享冷起动SFT,单回合感知RL和多回合感知Agentic RL来进行. 在共享工具使用协议下的7个基准中,PerceptRL平均精确度达到71.6%,以相同的工具超越了基准模型,并分别以15.7%和5.2个百分点最强的边疆VLM得到评价.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Fig. 1 : PerceptRL : making real-world perception rewardable, and training it at two levels. Center: How it becomes rewardable. Open-ended captions contain useful perceptual information but are difficult to score with direct rule-based rewards. We extract and verify perceptual facts from these captions, then formulate QA pairs with fixed answer labels for rule-based training (top).
The pipeline organizes tasks from multiple perception families ( e.g., color, spatial position, counting, functional state, orientation), using a perception tree to guide data construction (Section III-B ).
The difficulty axis is what divides the two levels. Level 1: Perception RL. A single look suffices here, so we train single-turn visual QA under a rule-based outcome reward.
The left panel shows what this must fix: an error entering at the perception level is inherited by an otherwise correct reasoning chain, so the answer is wrong for a purely perceptual reason. Level 2: Perception Agentic RL. This tail, where objects are small, scenes are cluttered, or details require magnification, resists a single look, so the model inspects the image over multiple grounded turns with a code interpreter.
The right panel illustrates how a grounding error, where a predicted crop or annotation misses its target, can affect subsequent observations. Its propagation and accumulation across successive tool interactions constitute coordinate drift . Coordinate Injection corrects these grounding errors during data construction, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises intermediate spatial fidelity (Section III-C ).

图1:感知RL:使现实世界感知得到回报,并在两个层面对其进行培训. 中点 : 如何变成有回报的。 开放式字幕包含有用的感知信息,但很难获得基于规则的直接奖励。 我们从这些标题中提取和验证感知事实,然后为基于规则的训练(上)制定带有固定答案标签的QA配对.
管道组织来自多种感知家族的任务(如颜色,空间位置,计数,功能状态,定向),使用感知树来指导数据构建(第三节-B节).
难度轴是将两个关卡分割开来的东西. 第1级:感应RL. 单张脸就足够了 所以我们在基于规则的结果奖励下训练单回合视觉QA.
左面板显示这必须修正什么:在感知层面输入的错误是由原本正确的推理链所继承的,因此答案出于纯粹的感知原因是错误的. 二级:感应剂RL. 这种尾巴,物体小,场景杂乱,或者细节需要放大,抵抗单一的外观,所以模型用一个代码解释器在多个被固定的转弯上检查图像.
正确的面板说明,在预测的作物或注释未能达到目标时,一个搁浅错误会如何影响随后的观测。 其传播和积累贯穿于各种工具的相互作用,构成坐标漂移。 坐标注入在数据构建过程中纠正了这些搁浅错误,而地面意识过程的奖励则监督中间空间忠诚度(第三节-C节)。

blocks.en:
The progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is fundamentally constrained by the quality of visual perception.
No matter how sophisticated a model’s reasoning capabilities, if it fails at the perceptual level ( e.g. , miscounting objects, confusing colors, or misjudging spatial relationships), downstream reasoning may produce wrong answers [ 1 , 2 ] .
Fine-grained perception therefore remains an important concern for current MLLMs [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
CodePercept [ 7 ] finds that scaling perception is more effective than scaling reasoning in its analysis of STEM visual reasoning.
A perceptual error can compromise an otherwise valid reasoning chain (Figure 1 , left).
blocks.zh:
多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的进展从根本上受到视觉感知质量的限制.
不论模型的推理能力多么精细,如果在知觉层面(例如,误计物体,混淆颜色,或误判空间关系)失败,下游推理可能会产生错误的答案[1,2].
因此,精细的感知仍然是目前最低生活水平[3、4、5、6]的一个重要关切。
CodePercept [7] 发现在对STEM视觉推理的分析中,缩放感知比缩放推理更有效.
知觉错误会损害本来有效的推理链(图1,左侧).

blocks.en:
Image–caption data provide an important source of visual supervision during the pre-training stage [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] .
However, production MLLMs undergo multiple stages, including ViT pre-training, vision–language alignment, instruction tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation [ 3 , 11 ] .
As the data mixtures and training objectives change, the influence of perception-focused captions used in the pre-training stage can be diluted by later optimization.
blocks.zh:
图像 - 封装数据在训练前阶段提供了一个重要的视觉监督来源[8,9,10].
然而,生产MLLM要经过多个阶段,包括ViT预训,视觉-语言配对,指令调谐,强化学习,以及政策蒸馏[3,11].
随着数据混合物和培训目标的变化,在培训前阶段使用的注重感官的字幕的影响可以通过以后的优化而减弱。

blocks.en:
A natural response is to continue optimizing captions during post-training, with reinforcement learning (RL) providing feedback on model-generated outputs.
For example, in mathematical reasoning, final answers can often be checked against reference solutions, giving RL objective feedback on generated solutions without requiring annotations for every reasoning step [ 12 , 13 ] .
Direct caption optimization, however, encounters two further difficulties. Subjectivity : factually correct captions can differ in granularity, emphasis, style, and length, making the desired optimization target difficult to specify. Unrewardability : captions are information-dense and open-ended, bundling numerous visual claims into one description. Constructing a verifiable reward requires deciding which claims to assess and how to combine their correctness into a caption-level score.
blocks.zh:
一个自然的反应是在培训后继续优化标题,强化学习(RL)提供模型生成产出的反馈。
例如,在数学推理中,最终的答案往往可以对照参考解来检查,给生成的解决方案提供RL客观的反馈,而不需要每个推理步骤[12,13]的注释.
然而,直接标题优化又遇到了两个困难。 主观性(subjective):事实上正确的标题在颗粒性,强调度,风格和长度上可能有所不同,使得理想的优化目标难以明确. 不可补偿性:标题是信息密集和无限制的,将许多视觉索赔捆绑在一起。 建立可核查的奖励要求决定哪些索赔需要评估,以及如何将其正确性与标题等级分数相结合。

blocks.en:
Solver-based methods [ 14 ] reward captions according to how well a vision-free LLM solver can answer visual questions using those captions.
This is an indirect perception signal: a high reward indicates that the caption provides information useful to the sampled questions and that the solver can exploit it, but does not establish that the caption captures the image accurately and comprehensively.
Visual details not required by those questions may remain unexamined.
blocks.zh:
基于解析器的方法 [14] 根据无视觉 LLM 解析器如何使用这些标题解析视觉问题来奖励字幕.
这是一个间接的感知信号:高赏表示标题提供了对被抽样的问题有用的信息,解答者可以加以利用,但没有确定标题能准确全面地捕捉图像.
这些问题不需要的视觉细节可能仍未审查。

blocks.en:
Code-based methods [ 7 ] use image-to-code-to-image reproduction to supervise visual perception, using code executability and reconstruction fidelity as reward signals.
However, this formulation is developed for structured STEM images that can be rendered programmatically; its generalization to diverse real-world images remains unestablished.
blocks.zh:
基于代码的方法[7]使用图像到代码到图像复制来监督视觉感知,使用代码可执行性和重建忠诚性作为奖励信号.
然而,这种配制是为结构化的STEM图像而开发的,这种配制可以程序化地渲染出来;其通俗化到各种现实世界的图像至今仍未确立.

blocks.en: These three issues raise a central question: how can we reinforce visual perception during post-training through objective optimization targets and verifiable rewards, so that the learned skills generalize across diverse perception tasks? We present PerceptRL , a framework that makes perceptual supervision explicit at two complementary levels: single-turn answers and multi-turn visual interactions (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 这三个问题提出了一个中心问题:我们如何能够通过客观优化目标和可核查的奖励,在培训后加强视觉感知,使所学技能能够概括各种感知任务? 我们提出PerceptRL,这个框架使概念监督在两个相辅相成的层面上明确:单回合答案和多回合视觉互动(图1)。

blocks.en:
Level 1: Perception RL. Our key insight is that the base model’s own perceptual errors can guide the construction of targeted, verifiable training data.
We design a multi-agent pipeline that first elicits dense captions from the base model, audits their visual claims, and cross-verifies detected errors against independent vision models.
The critical step is error composition : we turn verified visual facts associated with these errors into rewardable QA pairs , combining unrelated errors into multiple-choice questions and linking correlated errors into multi-step visual identification chains.
With fixed answer labels supported by cross-verification and human review, these questions provide rule-based outcome rewards, making caption-derived perceptual supervision explicit and verifiable.
Guided by a perception tree, specialized pipelines focus on selected high-error domains, while an error-agnostic general pipeline discovers and composes failures beyond those domains.
Both routes follow this error-driven principle, concentrating single-turn Perception RL on the model’s demonstrated perceptual weaknesses.
blocks.zh:
第1级:感应RL. 我们的关键见解是,基础模型本身的认知错误可以指导建立目标明确、可核查的培训数据。
我们设计了一个多代理管道,首先从基建模型中引出密集的字幕,审核他们的视觉诉求,对照独立视觉模型交叉验证发现的错误.
关键步骤是误差构成:我们将与这些误差相关的经核实的视觉事实转化为可奖励的QA对,将不相关的误差组合成多选择问题,并将相关误差连接成多步骤视觉识别链.
这些问题有固定的答案标签,辅之以交叉核查和人文审查,它们提供基于规则的结果奖励,使字幕衍生的观念监督明确和可核查。
在感知树的指引下,专门的管道侧重于选定的高误差域,而错误不可知的一般管道则发现并编造超出这些域的故障.
两条路线都遵循这个错误驱动的原则,将单回合感知RL集中在模型所显示的知觉弱点上.

blocks.en:
Level 2: Perception Agentic RL. For fine-grained, complex, and dense perceptual errors, where objects are small, scenes are cluttered, or details require magnification, single-turn answering often fails.
Tool use through a code interpreter can substantially help by enabling the model to inspect image regions over multiple turns.
Prior work has explored learning visual tool-use policies and integrating code execution into reasoning [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] .
In multi-turn visual inspection, however, choosing an appropriate tool or operation does not by itself ensure that the predicted crop or annotation lands on the intended target.
A grounding error occurs when a crop box or annotation point misses its intended target.
An incorrect crop may omit relevant evidence, while a misplaced annotation can mislead subsequent localization or counting.
If later turns depend on these observations, the initial error may propagate and compound across interactions.
We refer to this process as coordinate drift (Figure 1 , right).
This motivates a complementary focus on intermediate spatial fidelity alongside final-answer correctness.
To this end, Coordinate Injection (CI) constructs cold-start trajectories with corrected spatial coordinates, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises the spatial fidelity of intermediate operations during multi-turn RL.
blocks.zh:
二级:感应剂RL. 对于细腻,复杂,密集的感官错误,在物体小,场景杂乱的情况下,或者细节需要放大,单转答经常失败.
通过代码解释器使用工具,可以使模型能够通过多个转弯检查图像区域,从而大有帮助.
先前的工作探索了学习视觉工具使用政策,并将代码执行纳入推理[15,16,17,18].
然而,在多回合视觉检查中,选择适当的工具或操作本身并不能确保预测的作物或注释落在预定目标上。
当一个裁剪框或注释点错过其预定目标时,会出现搁浅错误。
错误的作物可能会省略相关证据,而错误的注释会误导随后的本地化或计数.
如果以后转向依赖于这些观测结果,初始误差可能会在相互作用中传播和复合.
我们把这一进程称为坐标漂移(图1,右)。
这促使在最后答案正确的同时,对中间空间忠贞性给予补充关注。
为此,坐标喷射(CI)用校正的空间坐标构建冷启动轨迹,而地面感知过程的奖励则在多转RL期间监督中间操作的空间忠诚性.

blocks.en: Training follows three sequential stages: a single shared cold-start SFT stage on a mixture of perception QA pairs and CI-corrected trajectories, followed by single-turn Perception RL and then multi-turn Perception Agentic RL. Each stage starts from the preceding checkpoint; there is no additional SFT stage between the two RL stages.
blocks.zh: 训练分为三个相继阶段:关于感知QA对和CI校正轨迹的单一共享冷启动SFT阶段,然后是单转感知RL,然后是多转感知Agentic RL. 每个阶段都从前一个检查站开始;两个RL阶段之间没有额外的SFT阶段.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We propose Perception RL to address the difficulty of defining verifiable rewards for open-ended image captions. It converts verified perceptual facts associated with the model’s caption errors into QA pairs with fixed answer labels, enabling single-turn post-training of visual perception with rule-based outcome rewards. Across eight perception benchmarks, this stage raises average accuracy from 61.9 % 61.9\% after cold-start SFT to 69.8 % 69.8\% (Table I ). • We propose Perception Agentic RL for fine-grained and dense perception requiring multi-turn inspection. To mitigate coordinate drift, Coordinate Injection corrects spatial operations in cold-start trajectories, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises intermediate grounding alongside answer correctness. Under the shared tool-use protocol, the full pipeline achieves 71.6 % 71.6\% average accuracy across seven benchmarks, outperforming the base model with the same tools and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 15.7 15.7 and 5.2 5.2 percentage points, respectively (Table II ).
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们提议“感知RL”,以解决难以确定可核查的对无限制图像标题的奖励的问题。 它将与模型标题错误有关的经核实的感知事实转换成带固定答案标签的QA对,从而能够进行基于规则的结果奖励的视觉感知的单回合后训练。 在8项感知基准中,这一阶段的平均准确度从冷启动SFT之后的61.9% 61.9%提高到69.8% 69.8 % (表一)。 我们提出感官RL 对于精细和密集的感官 需要多回合检查。 为了减缓坐标漂移,坐标喷射纠正了冷启动轨迹中的空间操作,而地面感知过程的奖励则监督中间着陆和答正确性. 根据共享工具使用协议,整个管道在7个基准中平均准确度达到71.6%,使用相同工具的基模和最强的前沿甚低频分别比基准高15.7 15.7和5.2 5.2个百分点(表二)。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Fine-Grained Visual Perception
blocks.zh: II-A 精致的视觉感知

blocks.en:
Fine-grained visual perception requires recovering local details and their spatial structure [ 19 , 20 ] .
Grounding DINO [ 21 ] combines language-guided feature fusion and grounded pre-training to detect objects specified by category names or referring expressions.
SAM [ 22 ] learns promptable segmentation from large-scale mask supervision, while Florence-2 [ 23 ] unifies captioning, detection, grounding, and segmentation through a common sequence-to-sequence formulation.
blocks.zh:
精细的视觉感知需要恢复局部细节及其空间结构[19,20].
定位DINO[21]结合了语言导特征聚变和基于定点的预训,以检测由类别名称或引用表达式指定的对象.
SAM [22]从大规模面具监督中学习快速分解,而佛罗伦萨-2 [23]通过常见的序列到序列配方,统一了标题,检测,地面,分解.

blocks.en:
Text-centric methods improve detection through feature refinement and synthetic-to-real pre-training [ 24 , 25 ] , and recognition through glyph alignment and character-level distillation [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] .
Structured document perception further incorporates symbol positions for mathematical expressions [ 29 ] , token-level supervision for dense text [ 30 ] , and joint question answering and mask generation [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh:
以文字为中心的方法通过特性的完善和合成-实际的预训[24,25],以及通过格莱弗调和字符级蒸馏的识别[26,27,28]来改进检测.
结构化的文件感知进一步包含了数学表达式的符号位置[29],对稠密文本的符号级监督[30],以及联合问答和遮罩生成[31].

blocks.en:
LReSeg [ 32 ] addresses reasoning segmentation with a small language model, using text-conditioned register tokens and a unified visual encoder for reasoning and mask decoding.
Wen et al. [ 33 ] reduce the cost of MLLM-based segmentation through delayed mask-token insertion and proxy-guided visual-token updates, preserving spatial details for dense prediction.
These studies emphasize explicit alignment between visual representations and spatially localized outputs.
blocks.zh:
LReSeg [32] 以小语言模型解决推理分解问题,使用文本条件的寄存符和用于推理和面具解码的统一视觉编码.
温等. [33]通过延迟的口罩卡通插入和代理制导的视觉卡通更新,降低基于MLLM的分区成本,为密密预测保留空间细节.
这些研究强调视觉表现与空间局部输出之间的明确一致。

blocks.en: In the medical domain, Hulu-Med [ 34 ] unifies text, 2D images, 3D volumes, and videos in a generalist VLM, using medical-aware visual token reduction to improve computational efficiency. PerceptRL investigates how to provide verifiable perception supervision across domains and spatial supervision for successive tool interactions during reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh: 在医学领域,Hulu-Med [34] 统一文本,2D图像,3D卷,以及一个通论VLM的视频,使用医学意识的视觉符号减少来提高计算效率. 受体RL研究如何提供可核查的跨域感知监督和空间监督,用于强化学习过程中的连续工具互动.

blocks.en: II-B Reinforcement Learning for VLMs
blocks.zh: II-B 增强对自愿活动的认识

blocks.en:
Reasoning-focused. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing reasoning in large language models [ 12 , 13 ] .
Its extension to vision-language models has attracted growing attention [ 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 ] .
Vision-R1 [ 39 ] constructs a 200K multimodal CoT dataset for cold-start initialization and employs GRPO [ 40 ] with progressive thinking suppression training.
VLM-R1 [ 41 ] applies rule-based RL to vision-language tasks with a focus on training stability and reward hacking mitigation.
R1-VL [ 42 ] introduces step-wise rewards to improve logical consistency in multimodal reasoning.
G1 [ 43 ] discovers that perception and reasoning abilities can mutually bootstrap each other during RL training through a perception-enhanced cold start on visual games.
AVAR [ 44 ] proposes the Visual Attention Score (VAS) to quantify visual token attention and designs attention-guided objectives to address lazy attention localization.
Despite these advances, the above methods primarily target reasoning capabilities, improving the logical process from visual evidence to conclusions, while leaving the perceptual accuracy of the visual evidence itself largely unaddressed.
blocks.zh:
理性专注. 以可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)已成为大语言模型中增强推理的有希望范例[12,13].
其推广到视觉语言模型,引起了越来越多的关注[35,36,37,38].
Vision-R1[39]为冷启动制造了200K的多式CoT数据集,并采用了GRPO[40],进行渐进式思维抑制训练。
VLM-R1[41]将基于规则的RL应用于视觉语言任务,重点是训练稳定性和奖励黑客缓解.
R1-VL[42]引入了渐进式奖励,以提高多式联运推理的逻辑一致性.
G1[43]发现感知和推理能力可以通过视觉游戏上感知增强的冷启动,在RL训练中互相牵制.
AVAR [44] 提出视觉注意力分数(VAS),以量化视觉符号注意力,并设计注意力引导目标,以解决懒惰注意力本地化问题.
尽管取得了这些进步,上述方法主要针对推理能力,改进了逻辑过程,从视觉证据到结论,同时使视觉证据本身的感知准确性基本得不到解决.

blocks.en:
Perception-focused. Perception-R1 [ 45 ] demonstrates via McNemar’s test that standard RLVR does not improve perception and proposes a visual perception reward for explicit perceptual supervision.
PAPO [ 46 ] introduces an implicit perception loss based on KL divergence between distributions conditioned on original versus corrupted visual inputs, achieving significant perception error reduction without external annotations.
V-Triune [ 47 ] proposes a Dynamic IoU reward for detection and grounding tasks, avoiding reward ambiguity under loose thresholds and reward sparsity under strict ones.
CodePercept [ 7 ] establishes code as a perceptual medium for STEM visual understanding, showing that scaling perception consistently outperforms scaling reasoning.
CapRL [ 14 ] redefines caption quality through downstream utility, rewarding captions that enable a vision-free LLM to answer visual questions, and demonstrates that RL-trained captioners can match much larger models.
blocks.zh:
感性专注. Perception-R1[45]通过McNemar的测试证明,标准的RLVR没有改善感知,并提出视觉感知对明确感知监督的奖励.
PAPO [46] 基于以原始视觉输入为条件的分布与腐败的视觉输入之间的KL差异,引入了隐含的感知损失,在没有外部说明的情况下实现了显著感知错误的减少.
V-Triune [47]提议对探测和定位任务给予动态IoU奖励,避免在松散的阈值下给予奖励模糊性,在严格阈值下给予奖励麻木.
CodePercept [7] 将代码确立为STEM视觉理解的感知介质,表明缩放感知一贯优于缩放推理.
CapRL [14] 通过下游效用重新定义字幕质量,奖励可以让无视觉LLM回答视觉问题的字幕,并表明经过RL训练的字幕可以匹配更大的模型.

blocks.en: II-C Thinking with Python
blocks.zh: II-C 与 Python 思维

blocks.en:
A growing line of work explores using code execution as a reasoning tool for VLMs [ 48 , 49 ] .
DeepEyes [ 15 ] learns to “think with images” via RL, using the model’s own grounding capability to dynamically crop and re-examine image regions during reasoning.
DeepEyesV2 [ 16 ] extends this to an agentic setting that interleaves code execution and web search within a single reasoning trajectory, employing a cold-start SFT stage followed by RL to establish robust tool-use patterns.
R1-Code-Interpreter [ 50 ] trains LLMs to autonomously generate code during step-by-step reasoning via multi-stage curriculum RL.
ReVPT [ 17 ] enhances VLMs’ ability to reason about and use visual tools through RL.
ToolsRL [ 18 ] proposes a two-stage curriculum that decouples tool mastery from answer optimization.
Spatial accuracy is a complementary concern in such tool-use settings, because later interactions may depend on the crops and annotations produced in earlier turns.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的工作线探索将代码执行作为VLMs[48,49]的推理工具.
DeepEyes[15]通过RL学习“用图像思考”,利用模型本身的地基能力在推理时动态收割和重新审查图像区域。
DeepEyesV2 [16] 将其延伸至一种代理设置,将代码执行和网络搜索在单一推理轨迹内互换,采用冷启动SFT阶段,然后是RL,以建立强大的工具使用模式.
R1-Code-解释 [50] 列车LLMs在分步推理过程中通过多阶段课程RL自动生成代码.
ReVPT [17] 增强了VLMs通过RL来解释和使用视觉工具的能力.
ToolsRL [18] 提出了从答案优化中解开工具掌握的两阶段课程.
空间精确性是此类工具使用环境中的一个补充性关切,因为以后的相互作用可能取决于早先的作物和说明。

blocks.en:
PerceptRL differs from prior work in two fundamental ways.
First, at the data level , we automatically mine the base model’s own perceptual errors and compose them into verifiable QA pairs, producing training signal that is both error-agnostic and scalable.
Second, at the supervision level , we combine Coordinate Injection for constructing spatially corrected training trajectories with a grounding-aware process reward that evaluates intermediate spatial fidelity during RL.
blocks.zh:
受体RL在两个基本方面与以前的工作不同.
首先,在数据层面,我们自动挖掘基础模型本身的感官错误,并将其编成可核查的QA对,产生既错误不可知又可扩展的训练信号.
第二,在监督一级,我们把坐标注入用于建造空间校正的训练轨迹与地面意识过程的奖励结合起来,评价中间空间忠诚度。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Overview
blocks.zh: 三. 概览

blocks.en:
PerceptRL operates at two complementary levels (Figure 1 ).
Level 1 (Perception RL) systematically probes the model’s perceptual weaknesses, converts the identified errors into verifiable QA pairs, and trains single-turn perception with a rule-based outcome reward.
However, its single-turn RL does not optimize iterative visual inspection, and small objects, densely packed scenes, or details requiring magnification can remain difficult to resolve from the full image alone.
This motivates Level 2 (Perception Agentic RL), which trains multi-turn visual inspection through a code interpreter for cropping, resizing, annotation, and measurement.
Such interactions require accurate spatial grounding: an incorrect crop or annotation can distort the evidence used in later turns and cause coordinate drift.
blocks.zh:
PerceptRL在两个互补层面运作(图1 )。
1级(Perception RL)系统探究模型的知觉弱点,将识别出的误差转换成可核查的QA对,并用基于规则的结果奖励来训练单转感知.
然而,它的单转RL并不能优化迭代视觉检查,而小物体,密集包装的场景,或需要放大的细节,仍然难以单独从完整的图像中解决.
这激励了二级(Perception Agentic RL),该级通过代码解释器进行多回合视觉检查,用于裁剪,再大小,注释和测量.
这种相互作用需要精确的空间定位:不正确的作物或注释会扭曲以后转向中使用的证据并造成坐标漂移。

blocks.en:
A single multi-agent pipeline underlies both levels, turning the base model’s own failures into training signal (Section III-B2 ): verifiable single-turn QA pairs for Level 1 and coordinate-corrected multi-turn agentic trajectories for Level 2.
On top of this data, the model is trained in three sequential stages, each initialized from the previous checkpoint (Figure 1 ):
(1) a single cold-start SFT on a mixture of the single-turn perception QA and the multi-turn CI-corrected trajectories, which provides training examples for single-turn perception QA and multi-turn tool use with CI-corrected coordinates;
(2) Level-1 Perception RL , single-turn RL from the cold-start checkpoint that trains on perception QA with a rule-based outcome reward; and
(3) Level-2 Perception Agentic RL , multi-turn RL that continues from the Level-1 checkpoint and additionally supervises the spatial fidelity of every intermediate step with a grounding-aware process reward.
The two levels describe the single-turn and multi-turn task settings; the three stages describe the training sequence.
blocks.zh:
单一的多剂管道是两个层次的基础,将基模型本身的故障转化为训练信号(第三节-B2节):1级可核查的单转式QA对和2级可协调校正的多转式剂轨迹.
除此数据外,该模型分三个相继阶段进行训练,每个阶段都从以前的检查站初始化(图1):
(1) 单转感应QA和多转感应CI校正轨迹的混合物上的单一冷启动SFT,它为单转感应QA和多转感应使用具有CI校正坐标的工具提供了培训实例;
(2) 1级感应RL, 单转RL,来自冷启动检查点,该检查点对感应QA进行训练,并按规则奖励结果;以及
(3)二级感应剂RL,从一级检点继续使用的多转式RL,并额外监督每个中间步骤的空间忠诚度,并给予地面感应过程奖励.
两级描述单回合和多回合任务设置;三个阶段描述训练序列.

blocks.en: III-B Perception RL
blocks.zh: 三-B 认知RL

blocks.en:
Current post-training is dominated by reasoning RL, which has substantially improved reasoning ability precisely because reasoning tasks admit abundant rewardable signals.
Perception, in contrast, has seen far less progress in the post-training stage: its natural supervision, captions, is subjective and open-ended, and thus difficult to formulate as a verifiable reward.
Perceptual errors can undermine subsequent reasoning, motivating explicit supervision of visual evidence [ 45 ] .
This motivates Level 1: to provide verifiable supervision across multiple perception task families during post-training.
blocks.zh:
目前后期训练以推理RL为主,这大大提高了推理能力,正是因为推理任务承认了丰富的有酬信号.
与此相反,在培训后阶段,人们所看到的进展要小得多:其自然监督、标题、主观性和开放性,因此很难作为可核查的奖励加以制定。
观念错误可能破坏后来的推理,激发对视觉证据的明确监督[45].
这激励了第1级:在培训后对多种观念家庭提供可核查的监督。

blocks.en:
Training across multiple perception skills calls for structured task organization: perception includes a broad range of fine-grained abilities, such as counting, color, orientation, and depth.
We therefore organize Level 1 as a three-step pipeline (Fig. 2 ). (i) We construct a three-level perception tree to organize fine-grained capabilities and guide model probing and data sampling. Two complementary routes support this construction: a specialized route for selected high-error domains and a general route for additional error types (Section III-B1 ). (ii) Along both routes, a multi-agent pipeline turns the base model’s own perceptual errors into deterministic, verifiable QA (Section III-B2 ). (iii) We train on this data with rule-based reward RL (Section III-B3 ).
blocks.zh:
跨越多种认知技能的培训需要结构化的任务组织:认知包括广泛的精细能力,如计数,颜色,定向,深度等.
因此,我们组织1级作为三步管道(图2)。 (一)构建三级感知树,组织精细化能力,指导模型检测和数据采样. 两条互补路线支持这一构建:选定高误差域的专用路线和额外误差类型的一般路线(第三节-B1. (二) 在两条路线上,一个多剂管线将基地模型本身的感知错误转变为确定性、可核查的质量保证(第三节-B节)。 (三) 我们用规则奖励RL(第III-B3节)对这些数据进行培训。

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 : Perception RL: from perceptual errors to rewardable QA. (01) Perception tree construction: A hierarchical capability map and model probing reveal perceptual weaknesses, guiding specialized and general data-construction routes. Appendix expands the displayed tree with additional skills and associated failure modes. (02) Rewardable QA construction: A multi-agent pipeline mines and verifies errors in the base model’s captions, then composes them into questions with unambiguous answers. MCQs combine unrelated errors, while chain QA connects correlated errors. (03) Rule-based reward for RL: The resulting QA pairs provide exact-match rewards for training the model’s visual perception.
The error distribution and example errors are illustrative.
blocks.zh:
图2:感知RL:从感知错误到可奖励的QA. (01) 感应树构造: 分级能力图和模型探测揭示了知觉弱点,指导专门和一般的数据构建路径. 附录以额外的技能和相关的失败模式扩展显示树. (02) 可补偿的质量保证建造:一个多代理管道矿井,并核实基准模型标题中的错误,然后将它们编成问题,并作出明确的答复。 MCQs结合了不相关的错误,而链式QA连接了相关错误. (03) 按规则奖励RL: 由此而来的QA配对为训练模型的视觉感知提供了精确的匹配奖励.
错误分布和实例错误是说明性的.

blocks.en: III-B 1 Perception Tree Construction
blocks.zh: III-B 1 构思树

blocks.en:
Perception is not a single scalar ability: a model may read colors reliably yet systematically miscount, or localize objects well yet confuse facing directions.
A structured decomposition helps identify perceptual weaknesses and organize data construction across related skills.
We therefore build a three-level perception tree that progressively organizes broad aspects of visual understanding into related capability groups and concrete perceptual tasks (Figure 2 ).
The hierarchy covers visual attributes, spatial relationships, and physical understanding, connecting high-level capability organization to the specific errors that guide training-data construction.
The figure illustrates representative branches of this organization, while Table in Appendix provides a more detailed capability map and associated failure modes.
blocks.zh:
感知并不是一种单一的scalar能力:一个模型可能会可靠地读取颜色,但却系统化地计算错误,或者将物体定位好,却混淆了面对的方向.
结构化的分解有助于识别知觉缺陷,组织跨相关技能的数据构建.
因此,我们建立了一个三级感知树,逐步将视觉理解的广泛方面组织成相关的能力组和具体感知任务(图2)。
等级涵盖视觉属性,空间关系,以及物理理解,将高级能力组织与指导培训数据构建的具体错误联系起来.
该图显示了该组织的代表性分支,而附录中的表格则提供了更详细的能力图和相关故障模式.

blocks.en:
With the tree in place, we probe the base model on sampled tasks associated with its capabilities and examine where its answers disagree with the reference labels.
The observed error patterns guide data allocation and the selection of task families for specialized construction, while the general route covers additional errors beyond these selected domains.
We use the following two construction routes: • Specialized route. For high-error nodes whose answers can be made cleanly and objectively verifiable, we build dedicated per-domain pipelines, currently for counting, color, spatial, and state, each with domain-specific verification ( e.g. , pixel-level color sampling, per-object box counting) and question templates. • General route. A single domain-agnostic pipeline handles errors beyond the selected specialized domains.
It discovers errors in the base model’s image descriptions and composes them into questions, providing a flexible way to sample additional task types. Both routes share the same error-driven construction principle (Section III-B2 ); they differ only in whether verification and composition are specialized to one node or applied generically.
The tree provides an organizational framework for data construction; empirical gains are assessed on the benchmark tasks reported in Section IV .
blocks.zh:
随着树的建立,我们调查了与树的能力相关的抽样任务的基础模型,并检查其答案与参考标签不一致的地方.
观测到的错误模式指导了数据分配和选择任务家族进行专门构建,而一般路径覆盖了这些选定域以外的额外错误.
我们采用以下两条建设路线: ——专用路线. 对于答案可以做到干净和客观可核查的高error节点,我们构建了专门的每个域的管道,目前用于计数,颜色,空间,和状态,每个节点都有特定域的验证(例如像素级的颜色取样,每个对象盒计数)和问题模板. • 一般路线。 单个域不可知管道处理所选专业域以外的错误.
它发现了基模型图像描述中的错误,并将其编成问题,提供了对额外任务类型进行抽样的灵活方法. 两种路线都具有相同的错误驱动的建造原则(第三节B2节);它们仅在核查和组成是专门适用于一个节点还是普遍适用方面有所不同。
该树为数据构建提供了组织框架;经验成果根据第四节报告的基准任务进行评估。

blocks.en: Specialized route. For high-error nodes whose answers can be made cleanly and objectively verifiable, we build dedicated per-domain pipelines, currently for counting, color, spatial, and state, each with domain-specific verification ( e.g. , pixel-level color sampling, per-object box counting) and question templates.
blocks.zh: 专用路线. 对于答案可以做到干净和客观可核查的高error节点,我们构建了专门的每个域的管道,目前用于计数,颜色,空间,和状态,每个节点都有特定域的验证(例如像素级的颜色取样,每个对象盒计数)和问题模板.

blocks.en:
General route. A single domain-agnostic pipeline handles errors beyond the selected specialized domains.
It discovers errors in the base model’s image descriptions and composes them into questions, providing a flexible way to sample additional task types.
blocks.zh:
总路线. 单个域不可知管道处理所选专业域以外的错误.
它发现了基模型图像描述中的错误,并将其编成问题,提供了对额外任务类型进行抽样的灵活方法.

blocks.en: III-B 2 Rewardable QA Construction
blocks.zh: 建筑工程

blocks.en:
The central insight shared by both routes is that perceptual errors are more informative than correct perceptions: rather than training on what the model already knows, we systematically discover what it gets wrong and build targeted data around those failures.
This decomposes data construction into two sub-problems: (i) reliably detecting the model’s genuine perceptual errors, and (ii) composing those errors into QA that is both challenging (it targets an actual weakness) and verifiable (it has an unambiguous correct answer).
We surface genuine errors through a three-stage multi-agent protocol. (1) Dense captioning : the base model produces an exhaustive multi-dimensional caption over the categories above. (2) Agent-based verification : a VLM audits the caption claim by claim (global checks on the full image, local checks on crops with quantitative measurement, and a scan for omissions), emitting each error as a structured JSON record. (3) Cross-verification : a second, independently chosen VLM re-checks every error, and only those confirmed by both are retained, filtering out single-model false positives. (4) Error composition : rather than filling fixed templates, a dedicated composition agent turns confirmed errors into QA pairs end-to-end, choosing which errors to target, phrasing them into one coherent question, and pairing the correct answer with crafted distractors under the quality gates below. Because it reasons about each error configuration rather than slotting values into a schema, it adapts question format, difficulty, and distractors to the errors an image exhibits, and chooses between two strategies by how the errors relate:
blocks.zh:
两种途径的共同中心见解是,感知错误比正确的看法更能说明问题:我们不是就模型已经知道的事情进行培训,而是系统地发现它的错误,并围绕这些失败建立有针对性的数据。
这就将数据构建分解为两个子问题:(一) 可靠地检测模型的真正感知错误,以及(二) 把这些错误编成既具有挑战性(目标是实际弱点)又可以核实(它有一个明确无误的正确答案)的质量保证。
我们通过一个三阶段的多剂协议 暴露出真正的错误 (1) 说明性说明:基准模型产生一个超越上述类别的详尽多维说明。 (2) 基于代理的核查:一个VLM通过索赔对标题索赔进行审计(对全图像进行全球检查,对作物进行定量测量的地方检查,并对遗漏进行扫描),将每个错误作为结构化的JSON记录。 (3)交叉核查 :第二,独立选择的VLM重新检查每一个错误,只有两者确认的被保留,过滤出单型假阳性. (4)错误组成 : 而不是填充固定的模板,专用的成分代理将确认的错误转换成QA对端对端,选择哪些错误来瞄准,把它们拼写成一个连贯的问题,并在下面的质量门下将正确的答案与精心设计的分光器配对. 因为它解释了每个错误配置的理由,而不是将数值排入一个方案,它使问题格式、难度和分散器适应一个图像显示的错误,并且根据错误的关联性在两个策略之间作出选择:

blocks.en:
MCQ format (unrelated errors). When an image contains multiple independent perceptual errors ( e.g. , a color error, a counting error, and a spatial error that concern different objects), we compose them into a multiple-choice question where each option (A–H) combines multiple visual claims.
Exactly one option has all claims correct; the distractors each contain one or more claims that correspond to verified errors.
This format produces questions with unambiguous single-letter answers, ideal for rule-based reward.
blocks.zh:
MCQ格式(无关错误). 当一个图像包含多个独立的感官错误(例如,颜色错误,计数错误,以及涉及不同对象的空间错误)时,我们将它们编成一个多选择问题,每个选项(A–H)结合多个视觉要求.
完全只有一个选项可以使所有索赔都正确;分散处理器各包含一个或数个与已核实错误相对应的索赔。
这种格式产生问题,有明确的单字母答案,理想的是以规则为基础的奖励.

blocks.en:
Chain QA format (correlated errors). When errors are spatially or semantically related ( e.g. , multiple spatial errors involving the same group of objects), we compose them into a multi-step visual identification chain: an initial candidate set → \to discriminating filter → \to intermediate anchor → \to further discrimination → \to unique target → \to atomic answer.
Each step in the chain requires a distinct perceptual capability, and the answer is only reachable by correctly executing all steps.
blocks.zh:
链式QA格式(cor相关错误). 当误差在空间或星系上相互关联时(例如,涉及同一类物体的多个空间误差),我们把它们编成一个多步骤的视觉识别链:初始候选集 → 区分过滤器 → 中间锚 → 进一步区分 → 唯一目标 → 原子答案 。
链条中的每一个步骤都需要不同的感知能力,只有正确执行所有步骤才能达到答案.

blocks.en:
Both formats yield deterministic, verifiable answers, and because every question is grown from a genuine error the base model made, learning concentrates on its weaknesses rather than rehearsing what it already perceives correctly.
This pipeline runs in the two routes of Section III-B1 : the general route composes errors sampled from different capability pools into one hard question, while the specialized route applies the same skeleton with domain-specific verification and templates to the highest-error, cleanly-verifiable nodes (Appendix ).
Both are governed by quality gates (capability coupling across ≥ \geq 3 skills, distractor resistance, anti-shortcut tests, explicit reference frames), and a final round of manual inspection screens the constructed QA pairs.
Human review serves as the final quality-control stage for the constructed questions and their answer labels, following automated cross-verification.
The rule-based reward used during RL then checks model outputs against these reviewed labels, separating label validation during data construction from reward computation during training.

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : Perception Agentic RL: correcting and supervising spatial grounding during multi-turn visual inspection. (01) Coordinate drift. A misplaced annotation changes the visual evidence available to later turns. Subsequent spatial operations can inherit this error, leading to repeated or missed counts. (02) Coordinate Injection (CI). During trajectory construction, CI identifies the intended target of each spatial operation, corrects its coordinates using a VLM judge or the LocateAnything detector, and re-executes the code before the next turn. The resulting per-turn rewards complement the final-answer reward and supervise intermediate spatial accuracy (Equation 17 ).

blocks.en:
Level 2 targets difficult perceptual queries involving small objects, cluttered scenes, or subtle color and state differences, for which a single view may not provide sufficient evidence.
The model therefore uses a code interpreter to crop, resize, annotate, and measure the image over multiple turns before answering.
A grounding error occurs when a crop box or annotation point misses its intended target.
If later turns rely on the resulting observation, this error can alter subsequent localization and counting decisions; we refer to the propagation and accumulation of such spatial misalignment as coordinate drift .
For example, misplaced marks in dense counting can cause later turns to revisit counted objects or omit unmarked ones (Fig. 3 , panel 01).
Final-answer correctness alone does not identify which intermediate spatial operations were accurate.
We address this supervision gap through two components: Coordinate Injection constructs trajectories with corrected spatial coordinates for cold-start SFT, and a grounding-aware process reward scores intermediate spatial fidelity during Level-2 RL.

The reward placed on token i i is R total ​ ( τ ) i \displaystyle R_{\text{total}}(\tau)_{i} = R acc ​ ( a , a ∗ ) ⏟ answer accuracy (all tokens) \displaystyle=\underbrace{R_{\mathrm{acc}}(a,a^{*})}_{\text{answer accuracy (all tokens)}} (18) + ∑ t = 1 T r t 1 [ i ∈ ℐ t ] ⏟ intermediate-turn supervision , \displaystyle+\underbrace{\sum_{t=1}^{T}r_{t}\,\mathbf{1}[\,i\in\mathcal{I}_{t}\,]}_{\text{intermediate-turn supervision}}, where a a is the final answer and R acc ​ ( a , a ∗ ) R_{\mathrm{acc}}(a,a^{*}) is the Level-1 exact-match reward of Equation 1 , so each token receives the outcome reward plus the reward of the turn that produced it.
The two terms supply credit at complementary granularities.
The outcome term R acc R_{\mathrm{acc}} is constant across all tokens of a trajectory, so it provides only across-trajectory credit: under the group-normalized advantage it separates a better rollout from a worse one, but is blind to which turn inside a rollout earned that outcome.
The per-turn term r t r_{t} instead varies from turn to turn, providing within-trajectory credit: a well-grounded turn is advantaged over a poorly grounded turn in the same trajectory, even when both share the same final answer.
Grounding fidelity is invisible to the across-trajectory term alone, so it is precisely this within-trajectory signal that lets RL reinforce accurate intermediate grounding rather than leave it unconstrained.

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
Base model and training. We build PerceptRL on Qwen3.6-Flash [ 64 ] as the base VLM, using the 35A3 mixture-of-experts variant ( ∼ \sim 35B total / ∼ \sim 3B active parameters), and train it in three stages, each initialized from the previous stage’s checkpoint:
(i) a cold-start SFT stage on 57,678 training examples comprising single-turn perception QA and CI-corrected multi-turn agentic trajectories from our pipeline, which jointly teaches the single-turn perception-answer format and the multi-turn perception-with-grounding format together with a drift-free multi-turn reasoning pattern;
(ii) Perception RL (Level 1), single-turn RL over 36,445 perception QA queries spanning multiple domains (Table III ), scored by a rule-based outcome reward;
and (iii) Perception Agentic RL (Level 2), multi-turn RL over the 19,810-query Agentic QA subset, scored by the grounding-aware process reward.
In both RL stages the model receives only queries and generates its own rollouts, which the reward then scores; no pre-collected trajectory is used as a supervision target.
Both RL stages use DAPO [ 51 ] , and training is run on 64 × \times A100 80GB.
The two stages differ in their optimization budget: Level 1 (Perception RL) uses a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , a batch size of 128, a DAPO group size of G = 8 G=8 , a maximum sequence length of 32K tokens, and 1 epoch, whereas Level 2 (Agentic RL) uses a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} , a batch size of 64, a group size of G = 8 G=8 , a maximum sequence length of 128K tokens, and 1 epoch.
During Level-2 rollouts the model drives a sandboxed Python code interpreter (crop, resize, annotate, and pixel/box measurement) for up to T = 64 T=64 turns per trajectory.

From single-turn to agentic QA. The two QA pools in Table III are constructed sequentially.
We first train the Level-1 model with Perception RL on the full Single-turn QA pool of 36,445 pairs.
After Level-1 training, we generate eight rollouts from the trained model for every query in this same pool and compute its empirical accuracy as c i / 8 c_{i}/8 , where c i c_{i} is the number of correct responses.
We retain queries satisfying c i / 8 < 5 / 8 c_{i}/8<5/8 , equivalently at most four correct responses out of eight, to form the 19,810-pair Agentic QA pool used for Level-2 RL.
This step selects existing QA pairs without adding new ones, so Agentic QA is a strict subset of Single-turn QA; their sizes are not additive.

Benchmarks. We evaluate on eight perception benchmarks, grouped by the capability they stress: general real-world VQA (RealWorldQA [ 65 ] , MMStar [ 66 ] ), multi-image and fine-grained grounded perception (BLINK [ 67 ] , TreeBench [ 68 ] ), embodied and spatial perception (ERQA [ 69 ] , which targets embodied reasoning, and RefSpatial-Bench [ 70 ] for referring spatial grounding), and object counting (CountQA [ 71 ] and real-world RealWorldCounting).

blocks.en: V-A Coverage of the Two Construction Routes

blocks.en:
Level 1 builds data along two routes (Section III-B1 ): a specialized route with per-domain pipelines for the high-error nodes (counting, color, spatial, state) and a general domain-agnostic route for the long tail.
To assess their respective contributions, we compare three Level-1 RL variants sharing the same SFT cold-start, RL recipe, and total query budget, differing only in which route supplies the data: specialized-only, general-only, and both.

为了评估它们各自的贡献,我们比较了三个共享相同的SFT冷启动、RL配方和总查询预算的一级RL变体,这些变体仅在提供数据的路由上有所不同:只有专用的,只有通用的,两者都有。

The general route achieves higher accuracy on RealWorldQA, MMStar, and BLINK, indicating a complementary benefit from broader domain coverage.
Combining both routes yields the highest accuracy on all eight benchmarks, including 71.9% on CountQA and 42.1% on RealWorldCounting. These results support the complementary contributions of domain-specific construction and general coverage under a matched data budget.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en:
We presented PerceptRL , a framework for improving visual perception in MLLMs during the post-training stage.
By converting the model’s perceptual errors into verifiable QA and combining CI-corrected trajectories with grounding-aware process reward, the framework provides training signals for both single-turn perception and multi-turn spatial grounding. The process-reward ablation shows improved grounding fidelity during training and final-answer accuracy gains across all four evaluated benchmarks.
Our two-level approach, Perception RL for single-turn QA and Perception Agentic RL for multi-turn tool use, improves aggregate performance across eight perception benchmarks, demonstrating that visual perception can be effectively optimized in post-training.
Future directions include extending to video perception with temporal consistency constraints, learning the grounding model jointly with the VLM, and applying CI to other agentic domains such as GUI interaction.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了PerceptRL,这是在培训后阶段提高MLLM的视觉感知的框架。
通过将模型的感知错误转化为可核查的质量保证,并将CI校正轨迹与地面知觉过程奖励相结合,框架为单转感知和多转空间定位提供了训练信号. 程序奖励的削减表明,在所有四个评估基准中,在培训和最后回答准确性提高的过程中,忠于职守的情况有所改善。
我们的两级方法,即单转QA的Peption RL和多转式工具使用的Peption Agentic RL,提高了8个感知基准的总性能,表明视觉感知可以在训练后有效优化.
未来的方向包括扩展至具有时间一致性限制的视频感知,与VLM共同学习地基模型,以及将CI应用于GUI交互等其他代理领域.
